data.one_liner: A timer widget that continues to work correctly even when the app is locked.
data.what_it_does: Provides a CountDownWidget that tracks time with a configurable duration and step duration. It exposes the remaining duration through a builder function and a callback.
use_when: You need a countdown timer displayed in the UI that must remain accurate even if the device locks.
You want a simple widget-based timer with callback support for duration changes.
avoid_when: You need complex background task execution rather than just a UI countdown widget.
You require advanced state management integration beyond the provided builder pattern.
strengths: Works correctly even if the app is locked.
Provides a simple builder pattern to easily render remaining time.
Supports autoStart configuration and custom step durations.
weaknesses: Very limited documentation and configuration options beyond basic countdown features.
No alternative packages available in the catalog to compare against.
